implementation: The twenty-eighth unmerged LibreCAD patch captures bounded immutable empty XRECORD typed observations, latches duplicate/allocation failure, includes the capture in the selected import-session seal, and correlates a unique live XRECORD, raw frame, publication, coverage entry and verified owning dictionary membership. It does not enable XRECORD output.
validation: A standalone installed-codec consumer matched the locally authored ODA AC1024 source dictionary B003 / OTHER / XRECORD B200 relationship. All 112 calibrated allocation failures refused and each immediately retried successfully; a capture allocation failure latched, cleared and retried. Duplicate capture invalidated the source session.

The actual LibreCAD importer test passed 21 assertions covering the sealed source, wrong dictionary/name, changed dictionary entry, changed XRECORD and wire owner, duplicate invalidation and same-filter reimport. All three installed-codec focused CTests passed.

The patch applies after the prior 27 patches and the macro-excluded older bundled-codec filter compile check passes. Source-release inventory passes with 1224 files and 18 refusal controls; the 724-input implementation digest remains 64a2959853ace89b7d87ce130bdedda8c2a6f64aaec1cb203295dfe1b3220d83.
limits: Only the selected source relationship of one locally generated ODA file is observed. The session seal covers selected callbacks, not all possible live edits; graph closure, empty-XRECORD output, native CAD acceptance, title-block data and broader support claims remain open. No drawing fixture is committed.
